parameters.query: WITH recovery AS (UPDATE bot_messages SET status='pending', sending_started_at=NULL, next_retry_at=(NOW() + INTERVAL '2 minutes'), last_error=COALESCE(last_error||' [recovery]','[recovery]'), updated_at=NOW() WHERE status='sending' AND sending_started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes') UPDATE bot_messages SET status='sending', sending_started_at=NOW(), send_attempt_id='att_'||EXTRACT(epoch FROM NOW())::bigint||'_'||id, updated_at=NOW() WHERE status='pending' AND scheduled_at <= NOW() AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) RETURNING *
UPDATE bot_messages SET status=$2, waha_message_id=$3, sent_at=$4, retry_count=$5, next_retry_at=$6, last_error=$7, sending_started_at=$8, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1
